|rightarm = 7E369E |shorts = 7E369E |socks = 7E369E |title = Special }} |} ==Season summary== ===Background and pre-season=== In June 2025, ahead of the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]], Argentine forward [[Joaquín Correa]] left Inter to join [[Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas|Botafogo]],{{cite press release|url=https://www.botafogo.com.br/noticias/botafogo-joaquin-correa-oficializa-contratacao-atacante-argentino|title=Bienvenido, Tucu!|date=10 June 2025|access-date=11 July 2025|language=pt-BR|publisher=Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas}} while the club strengthened their squad by signing Croatian midfielder [[Petar Sučić]] from [[GNK Dinamo Zagreb|Dinamo Zagreb]] and Brazilian winger [[Luis Henrique (footballer, born 2001)|Luis Henrique]] from [[Olympique de Marseille]]. Inter also promoted promising youth academy talent [[Francesco Pio Esposito]] to the first team following his return from a loan spell at [[Spezia Calcio|Spezia]].{{cite web |url=https://www.sportmediaset.mediaset.it/mercato/inter/l-inter-ha-deciso-pio-esposito-resta-nerazzurro-al-100-_100257568-202502k.shtml |title=L'Inter ha deciso: Pio Esposito resta nerazzurro al 100% |date=26 June 2025 |publisher=Sport Mediaset |language=it |access-date=2 September 2025}} Additionally, the club exercised their option to make [[Nicola Zalewski]]'s move from [[AS Roma|Roma]] permanent. Following the conclusion of the [[2024–25 Inter Milan season|2024–25 season]], Inter parted ways with Austrian striker [[Marko Arnautović]] after his contract expired.{{cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/it/liste/arnautovic-annuncia-l-addio-all-inter-il-mio-tempo-qui-e-finito/blt30f4d5799e0b2d1d |title=Arnautovic annuncia l'addio all'Inter: "Il mio tempo qui è finito" |date=8 June 2025 |publisher=Goal.com |language=it |access-date=11 July 2025}} On 5 July 2025, Inter officially announced the signing of French striker [[Ange-Yoan Bonny]] from [[Parma Calcio 1913|Parma]] for a reported fee of €23 million plus bonuses. On 18 August, Zalewski left Inter to join [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] in a transfer reportedly worth €17 million. Four days later, on 22 August, French midfielder [[Andy Diouf]] was signed from [[RC Lens|Lens]] for a reported €20 million fee. On 25 August, [[Kristjan Asllani]] joined [[Torino FC|Torino]] on a season-long loan that includes an option to buy for around €12 million. ===August=== On 25 August 2025, Inter began their [[2025–26 Serie A|Serie A]] campaign with a commanding 5–0 victory against Torino, as [[Alessandro Bastoni]], [[Marcus Thuram]] (who netted a brace), [[Lautaro Martínez]] and new signing Ange-Yoan Bonny all found the scoresheet.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/736791|title=Inter Milan smash Torino 5-0 to start Serie A in style|date=26 August 2025|language=en|publisher=ESPN}} On 31 August, [[Mehdi Taremi]] departed Inter after just one season, moving to [[Super League Greece|Super League Greece]] club [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]]. On the same day, the team suffered their first defeat of the season, as [[Udinese Calcio|Udinese]] came from behind to claim a 2–1 victory after [[Denzel Dumfries]] had initially put Inter ahead.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/736800|title=Udinese rally to stun Inter Milan at San Siro|date=31 August 2025|language=en|publisher=ESPN}} ===September=== On deadline day, Inter finalised two defensive moves: Swiss centre-back [[Manuel Akanji]] was brought in from [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] on a season-long loan, while French defender [[Benjamin Pavard]] was loaned to Marseille for the same duration. Inter's first game of September was against [[Derby d'Italia|rivals]] [[Juventus F.C.|Juventus]] at [[Juventus Stadium]]. [[Lloyd Kelly]] would open the scoring for Juventus but [[Hakan Calhanoglu]] would equalise in the 30th minute before [[Kenan Yildiz]] made it 2-1 eight minutes later with the first half finishing 2-1 to Juventus. Calhanoglu would equalise for the 2nd time in the 65th minute before [[Marcus Thuram]] gave Inter the lead for the first time in the 76th minute. Juventus would then equalise with Marcus Thuram's brother, [[Khephren Thuram]] scoring in the 80th minute before Juventus grabbed the winner in stoppage time with a [[Vasilije Adzic]] long range effort. This left Inter 11th in the league after 3 games.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c7495q8pw59t|title=Juventus 4-3 Inter Milan: French brothers Khephren and Marcus Thuram both score in Serie A thriller|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then begin their [[2025-26 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] campaign away to [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] at the [[Johan Cruijff ArenA]]. They would go onto to win the game 2-0 after goals from Marcus Thuram late in the first half and early in the second half.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c4g5e0ymynpt|title=Ajax 0-2 Inter Milan: Marcus Thuram scores twice in victory|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then win their next two league games, beating [[US Sassuolo Calcio|Sassuolo]] 2-1 at home{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c2dn5dnw83zt|title=Inter Milan 2-1 Sassuolo: Inter hold on for first win since start of season|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} and [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] 2-0 away{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cn9577ly3rdt|title=Cagliari vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} moving them up to 5th in the table. Inter would then finish September by beating [[SK Slavia Prague|Slavia Prague]] 3-0 in the champions league at the San Siro putting them third in the league phase table after two games.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c3e7d4vd8vdt|title=Inter Milan 3-0 Slavia Prague: Lautaro Martinez scores twice in easy Inter win|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} ===October=== Inter would begin October by defeating [[US Cremonese|Cremonese]] 4-1 at the San Siro moving them up into the champions league places with debutant [[Ange-Yoan Bonny]] scoring a goal and assisting Lautaro Martinez, [[Fedrico Dimarco]] and [[Nicolo Barella]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c4gvxpgwkvnt|title=Bonny stars as Inter thrash Cremonese to go joint top|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then beat league leaders [[AS Roma|Roma]] 1-0 at the [[Stadio Olimpico]] to move up to second in the league.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/clyznp4np4jt|title=Roma 0-1 Inter Milan: Ange-Yoan Bonny goal sends Inter top of Serie A|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then keep up their winning start to the champions league by taking a 4-0 away win to [[Royale Union Saint-Gilloise|Union Saint-Gilloise]] with Denzel Dumfries, Lautaro Martinez, Hakan Calhanoglu and [[Francesco Pio Esposito]] all on the scoresheet as Inter moved up to third in the league phase table.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/ce9dgdn8er5t|title=Inter beat USG to keep 100% Champions League record|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then travel to the [[Stadio Diego Armando Maradona]] to face defending champions [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]]. Napoli would take the lead after a [[Kevin De Bruyne]] penalty in the 33rd minute, with the hosts doubling their advantage in the 54th minute after a goal from [[Scott McTominay]]. Hakan Calhanoglu would get a goal back from a penalty before [[Frank Anguissa]] sealed the points before Napoli in the 66th minute.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c751zgpdwx9t|title=Napoli 3-1 Inter Milan: Scott McTominay scores as champions go top of Serie A table|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} This left Inter 4th in the league 3 points off 1st placed Napoli. Inter would finish October by defeating [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] 3-0 at the San Siro moving them up to third place in the league 3 points behind Napoli.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c4gzrx07xnkt|title=Inter Milan vs Fiorentina: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} ===November=== Inter would begin November with an away trip to [[Hellas Verona FC|Hellas Verona]]. Inter would take the lead after a [[Piotr Zieliński]] scored in the 16th minute but [[Giovane (footballer, born 2003)|Giovane]] would equalise in the 40th minute. Inter would then win the game after Verona defender [[Martin Frese]] stoppage time own goal moving them up to second place in Serie A.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cm2eve51m5nt|title=Hellas Verona vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then continue their 100 percent record in the champions league by beating [[FC Kairat|Kairat]] 2-1 at the San Siro keeping Inter third in the league phase table with 12 points.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c70jje91lx1t|title=Inter Milan survive scare against Kairat to win|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter followed up their champions league win by beating [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] 2-0 at the San Siro to move them top of the league on goal difference, the first time since matchday 1 they had topped the league.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cvgdnn100gqt|title=Inter Milan 2-0 Lazio: Lautaro Martinez and Ange-Yoan Bonny send Inter to top of Serie A|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's next game was against [[Derby della Madonnina|city rivals]] [[AC Milan]] with Inter as the designated home team. After a goalless first half, [[Christian Pulisic]] would give Milan the lead in the 54th minute and despite getting a penalty 17 minutes later Çalhanoglu's penalty would be saved by [[Mike Maignan]] and Milan would win 1-0 dropping Inter to 4th in the league 3 points behind Roma.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/ce9dk50l7g5t|title=Pulisic hits winner as Milan beat Inter to go second|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then suffer their first defeat in the champions league to [[Atlético Madrid]] after conceding a stoppage time goal dropping them to 4th in the league phase table.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c2epdmjxdw8t|title=Atletico Madrid 2-1 Inter Milan: Jose Maria Gimenez scores winner for hosts|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then finish November with a trip to newly promoted [[Pisa SC|Pisa]]. They would go onto to win 2-0 after a brace from Lautaro Martinez which moved Inter up to third place in the league 2 points behind leaders Milan.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cedx9788yzjt|title=Pisa vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} ===December=== Inter's [[2025-26 Coppa Italia|Coppa Italia]] began in the round of 16 at home to Serie B club [[Venezia FC|Venezia]]. Inter would defeat the Serie B side 5-1 with Marcus Thuram grabbing a brace, confirming Inter's spot in the quarter finals.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cn09yk2z979t|title=Inter Milan vs Venezia: Coppa Italia stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's first league of December was at home to [[Como 1907|Como]]. They would win the game 4-0 with Martinez, Thuram, Çalhanoğlu and [[Carlos Augusto (footballer)|Carlos Augusto]] all on the scoresheet as Inter moved top of the league temporarily until wins for Milan and Napoli put them back in third place.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c23e0m9zp2vt|title=Inter Milan vs Como: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then suffer a late defeat to [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] in the champions league after conceding a penalty in the 88th minute which was converted by [[Dominik Szoboszlai]]. The loss put Inter 5th in the league phase table but saw their gap to the playoff phase reduced to 1 point.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c0r9v8ke20yt|title=Inter Milan 0-1 Liverpool - Dominik Szoboszlai's late penalty clinches victory for Reds|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then bounce back from the loss by beating [[Genoa CFC|Genoa]] 2-1 away from home moving them top of the league by one point.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cj01e8410p8t|title=Genoa vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then face [[Bologna FC 1909|Bologna]] in the [[2025-26 Supercoppa Italiana|Supercoppa Italiana]] semi finals. Thuram would give Inter the lead in the second minute but Bologna would equalise in the 35th minute after [[Yann Bisseck]] handled the ball in the area with [[Riccardo Orsolini]] converting the penalty. The game would finish 1-1 resulting a penalty shootout. Inter would lose the shootout 3-2 after [[Alessandro Bastoni]], Nicolò Barella and Ange-Yoan Bonny all failed to convert their kicks eliminating them from the Supercoppa and ending their chances of claiming the first silverware of the season.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cgexz37gr8vt|title=Bologna vs Inter Milan: Super Cup stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would bounce back by beating [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] 1-0 away from home in their final game of 2025, meaning they ended the year top of the Serie A table with 36 points.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c8jwd8llmk2t|title=Atalanta vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} ===January=== Inter would begin 2026 by getting revenge on Bologna for the Supercoppa Italiana semi final defeat with a 3-1 win at the San Siro keeping them top of the league by one point.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c394kv9vm90t|title=Inter Milan vs Bologna: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would then follow up this result by beating [[Parma Calcio 1913|Parma]] 2-0 away from home and with Milan drawing the next day Inter extended their lead at the top of the table to 3 points.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cx2pynxlkr7t|title=Parma 0-2 Inter Milan: Inter move four points clear in Serie A|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's next game would be against defending champions Napoli at the San Siro. Fedrico Dimarco would open the scoring for Inter before Scott McTominay would draw Napoli level in the 26th minute with the first half ending 1-1. Çalhanoğlu would give Inter the lead again in the 73rd minute from a penalty before McTominay would equalise again 8 minutes later. The game would finish 2-2 which kept Inter 3 points ahead of second placed Milan in the title race. Inter's next game was the delayed game against [[US Lecce|Leece]] due to Inter's participation in the Supercoppa Italiana. Inter would win the game 1-0 after a Pio Esposito goal in the 78th minute extending their lead to 6 points until Milan won the next day to cut the gap back to 3.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c0erln42p0yt|title=Inter Milan vs Lecce: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's next league game was away to Udinese. They would win 1-0 after a Lautaro Martinez goal in the 20th minute keeping them 3 points clear of Milan in the title race.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/c5y26l5yje0t|title=Udinese vs Inter Milan: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's first champions league game of 2026 was at home to league phase leaders Arsenal. Arsenal would open the scoring after a [[Gabriel Jesus]] goal in the 10th minute but [[Petar Sucic]] would equalise in the 18th minute. However Jesus would give Arsenal the lead back in the 31st minute before [[Viktor Gyokeres]] scored to give Arsenal the win dropping Inter to 14th in the league phase.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/czx1y158wl1t|title=Inter Milan 1-3 Arsenal: Gabriel Jesus scores twice as Gunners guarantee top-two spot|website=BBC Sport}} Inter would bounce back from the champions league defeat by defeating Pisa 6-2 and with Milan drawing to Roma, Inter extended their lead at the top of the table to 5 points.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cvgjk84vpp9t|title=Inter Milan vs Pisa: Serie A stats & head-to-head|first=Live|last=Text|website=BBC Sport}} Inter's final game of January was against [[Borussia Dortmund]] in the champions league.
